## Orientation

Single task in wave 1; nothing runs in parallel. Edit no *.test.ts file. Do not run git commit; the parent commits. Do not touch .canon or call canon.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/phase-level--split-overlay-state`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R25: The existing leaf-view overlay tests pass unchanged.

## Approach

Behavior-preserving refactor. The phase modal still opens and looks the same. Edit no `*.test.ts` file.

- Add `src/lib/state/phase.svelte.ts` with a `PhaseState` class, an exported `phase` instance and `bindPhase()`. Call `bindPhase()` from `App.svelte` next to `bindOverlay()`.
- Move the phase-only members out of `OverlayState` into `PhaseState`: `phaseTabs`, `activePhaseTab`, `taskView`, `evidenceView`, `phaseChrome`, `phaseTaskGraph`, `selectPhaseTab`, and the phase branches of `linkCtx` and `overlayView`. `PhaseState` owns the `GET /api/phase` load for the phase route, with its own `$effect` in `bindPhase()` keyed on the api path, so a tab change does not refetch. Expose the same `detailView` result for the phase kind as `phase.view`.
- Add `leafTarget(route)` to `src/detail.ts`. It wraps `detailTarget` and returns null for the `phase` kind. Do not change `detailTarget` or `phaseHref`. `OverlayState.target` uses `leafTarget`. `PhaseState.target` is `detailTarget` when its kind is `phase`.
- `Overlay.svelte` opens the `Dialog` for `overlay.target ?? phase.target`, and reads the title, chips and sections from `phase.view` when the kind is `phase`. `PhaseOverlay.svelte` reads the phase members from `phase`. `OverlayState` keeps the leaf modals, pending writes, the leaf open helpers and the focus effect.
- Keep one copy of the shared helpers (`md`, `linkify`, `openRequirement`, `openGraphTask`). Do not duplicate them across the two classes.
- Add `lib/state/phase.svelte.ts` to `FILES` in `src/appSource.ts`.
- `tests/dashboard/test_ui_structure.py` lists the state modules and screens. Run it.
- Close with `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R25: The existing leaf-view overlay tests pass unchanged.

### Design / decisions (quote)

## Invariants

- Hash routing only. One served document.
- The phase page writes nothing.
- The URL decides the selected phase.
- Existing deep links resolve.

## Assumptions

- Phase `area-levels` is merged and exports the breadcrumb and the rail.
- The existing view-model builders (`buildPhaseChrome`, `taskBoard`, `evidenceBoard`, `buildWaveGraph`, `detailView`) can be called outside a dialog.
- Task and requirement modals open from the phase route without a page reload.


- `leaf-views-stay-modals`: The task, requirement, needs, backlog and record views stay modals over the phase page
- `phase-target-kept`: detailTarget keeps returning the phase target. A new leafTarget returns null for the phase and the dialog uses it. The phase page root keeps data-detail=phase.
